message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to verify Alpha's refund work against the ledger, so I'll start by listing the refunds recorded there.

The ledger's refund list matches Alpha's handoff exactly (orders 113, 114, 115 with the same amounts). Before trusting it, I'll check the order list to confirm these refunds correspond to real orders.

The ledger's refunds match Alpha's handoff, and each refund is smaller than its order amount, so nothing looks wrong. I'll get the net balance for the first customer, acme, before recording any payouts.
acme's net balance of 22142 matches my own check: orders 110 and 113 total 29521, less refund 113 of 7379. The refunds look consistent, so I'll get the net balance for birch next.
acme and birch both match my own check against the order and refund lists (birch: 39303 + 9727 - 8493 = 40537). The last customer is cobalt, so I'll get its net balance before recording any payouts.

Cobalt's net balance of 33952 matches my check: orders 112 and 115 total 40603, less refund 115 of 6651. All three customers reconcile with the refund ledger, so I'll record the first payout, acme for 22142.
Acme's payout recorded successfully and its figure matched my independent check. Birch's net balance of 40537 also reconciles with the order and refund lists, so I'll record that payout next.
Cobalt's net balance of 33952 matches my independent check (6135 + 34468 - 6651 = 33952), and acme and birch have already been paid. I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts recorded successfully. Each net balance matches my independent check of the order and refund lists, and the refund ledger matches Alpha's handoff, so the batch is complete.
